title: Twin primes: Brun's theorem and a prime-pair bound uniform in the shift
summary: Lean proof of Brun's theorem (sum of 1/p over twin primes converges) and #{p < N : p, p+h prime} <= 2^13 K(h)^2 N/(log N)^2 uniformly in even h, by Selberg's sieve; the conjecture stays open (parity barrier).
notes: brun_summable, twinCount_le, pairCount_le_log, pairCount_le_uniform; inlines the Selberg sieve of PrimeNumberTheoremAnd (Mellendijk, Apache 2.0, commit 127b50e3). K(h)^2 in place of the sharp singular series. Outside Lean: none.

sources.cite: lean-eval problem brun_constant_converges (7 accepted solutions, private or unreachable, 2026-06 to 08)
sources.what: Brun's theorem in Lean, not public

prior_art.note: Brun's theorem has non-public Lean proofs; the uniform-in-h bound has no Lean version found.

title: Lehmer's totient problem: Carmichael, at least 4 prime factors, finiteness for fixed K
summary: A composite n with phi(n) | n-1 is odd, squarefree, Carmichael, has at least 4 distinct prime factors, and n <= (2K)^(2^K-1) with K prime factors (so finitely many for each K); Lean.
notes: isCarmichael_of_isLehmer, prime_lt_of_isLehmer (Pomerance 1977 Lemma 3), le_bound_of_isLehmer, finite_isLehmer_card, four_le_card_of_isLehmer. Outside Lean: Pomerance's sharper K^(2^K) and the literature bounds omega >= 7..15.

prior_art.note: All results classical; no Lean version found.

title: Composite c with 2^(c-1) = 1 mod c^2: no c = 1093^a P^k or 3511^b P^k
summary: Cofactor lemma plus certified factorisations of 2^1092 - 1 and 2^3510 - 1: no base-2 Wieferich pseudoprime c = p^a P^k with p in {1093, 3511} and any prime P; what remains is c with three or more Wieferich prime factors, two unknown Wieferich primes, or a prime power of a new Wieferich prime.
notes: wief_cofactor, wief_prime_factor, wief_sq_factor, wief_no_1093_3511, sq_dvd_two_pow_1092 (45-prime factorisation with Pratt certificates), wief_no_1093_prime_power. Extension (wieferich_composite_3511_mathlib.lean): sq_dvd_two_pow_3510, wief_no_3511_prime_power from the full factorisation of 2^3510 - 1 (factordb + PARI, product and 66 Pratt certificates checked in Lean). Outside Lean: primality of one 146-digit factor of Phi_1755(2) (hypothesis h146 of the 3511 theorems; PARI APRCL, factordb proven); the 1093 results have nothing outside Lean.

sources.what: prime factors are Wieferich; 1093^2, 3511^2 and 1093*3511 excluded

prior_art.note: The cofactor form and the exclusion of all 1093 P^k were not found stated; possibly new.

title: Goormaghtigh: exponent pairs (3,5) and (3,7) in Lean
summary: The 3-digit repunit in base x equals the 5-digit repunit in base y (y >= 2) only for 31 = 111_5 = 11111_2, and never the 7-digit one; Runge-type squeeze, Lean.
notes: goor35, goor35_repunit, goor37, goor37_repunit. Smallest unsettled pair (4,6): Runge fails (x^3 - y^5 irreducible), no modular obstruction. Outside Lean: none.

title: Sumner's conjecture for n <= 5 in Lean
summary: Every tournament on 2n-2 vertices contains every oriented tree on n vertices, for n <= 5; kernel-checked certificate (tournament classification by one-vertex extension, tree parent codes).
notes: SumnerSmall.sumner_le_five (definitions copied from formal-conjectures). n = 6 needs about 1000x the work (9.7 million tournament classes on 10 vertices). Outside Lean: none.

title: Odd perfect numbers: Touchard, Sylvester's 105, three prime factors
summary: An odd perfect N satisfies N = 1 (mod 12) or 9 (mod 36), is not divisible by 105, and has at least 3 distinct prime factors; Lean.
notes: oddPerfect_touchard, oddPerfect_not_dvd_105, oddPerfect_three_primeFactors and lemmas. Sylvester's 4 prime factors needs prime factors of sigma(p^a) for all a (primitive divisors; not in Mathlib). Outside Lean: none.
